CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_local_report_configs (
 client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 template VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
 landing_url TEXT NOT NULL,
 project_id INTEGER REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 settings JSONB NOT NULL,
 roadmap JSONB NOT NULL,
 updated_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT ck_local_report_configs_landing CHECK (landing_url ~ '^https?://')
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_local_reports (
 id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 period_start DATE NOT NULL,
 period_end DATE NOT NULL,
 datos JSONB NOT NULL,
 roadmap JSONB NOT NULL,
 inputs JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
 warnings JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
 checks JSONB,
 computed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 ai_status VARCHAR(12),
 ai_started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 ai_error TEXT,
 ai_drafted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 file_stem VARCHAR(120),
 html BYTEA,
 pdf BYTEA,
 generated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 generated_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 delivered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 delivered_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT ck_local_reports_period CHECK (period_start <= period_end),
 CONSTRAINT ck_local_reports_ai_status CHECK (ai_status IS NULL OR ai_status IN ('running','done','failed')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_local_reports_files CHECK ((html IS NULL) = (pdf IS NULL)),
 CONSTRAINT ck_local_reports_delivered CHECK (delivered_at IS NULL OR generated_at IS NOT NULL)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_local_reports_client_period ON client_local_reports (client_id, period_start DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_local_reports_open_period ON client_local_reports (client_id, period_start, period_end) WHERE delivered_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_local_report_sources (
 id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 report_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES client_local_reports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
 filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
 content_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
 content BYTEA NOT NULL,
 size INTEGER NOT NULL,
 uploaded_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT ck_local_report_sources_kind CHECK (kind IN ('gbp_actual','gbp_anterior','gbp_ano_anterior','rastreo','captura','otro')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_local_report_sources_size CHECK (size > 0 AND size <= 10485760)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_local_report_sources_report ON client_local_report_sources (report_id)
